title: Guide to the Graduation Thesis in History
summary: The Guide to the Thesis Work in History is a reference tool aimed at those who, at the end of their three-year or master's degree course, have to tackle a thesis in historical disciplines. It offers suggestions and indications for the different phases of the thesis work: from the choice of the topic, to the collection and processing of data gathered during bibliographic and source research, to the drafting of the final thesis in all its parts. It is also the result of an active collaboration between teachers, librarians and students, who work and study at the Department of Humanities and the Humanistic Area Library of Ca’ Foscari University, Venice.
